main.description: Run COLMAP CPU dense reconstruction over a curated image set. Pipeline: feature_extractor (SIFT CPU) → exhaustive_matcher → mapper (incremental SfM) → image_undistorter → patch_match_stereo (CPU, 4-thread) → stereo_fusion → delaunay_mesher. Inputs are Mapillary URLs (worker downloads to ephemeral /tmp); output is a vertex-colored triangle mesh stored in B2. Wall-clock budget per tile = 60 min hard timeout (BPMN boundary); typical 30-45 min on 2 cores @ 2.5 GHz with 30 images at 1080p. On failure emits a structured error so `replanReconstruction` can decide retry|downgrade-to-osm|abort.

denseEnabled.description: False = sparse-only fallback (skip patch_match_stereo). Default true.

matcher.description: exhaustive | sequential | spatial. Default exhaustive (best quality, slowest).

rawMeshUri.description: B2 URI of meshed.ply (vertex-colored triangle mesh) when ok=true.

errorCode.description: On failure: TOO_FEW_MATCHES | BUNDLE_DIVERGED | DENSE_OOM | TIMEOUT | UNKNOWN.
